## Chat History Management
Grok CLI automatically saves chat sessions to `.grok/chat-history/` directory. Sessions can be managed via:
- **CLI flag**: `grok --load-chat-session <sessionId>` loads a saved session at startup - **Interactive command**: `/restore` lists sessions; `/restore <sessionId>` loads immediately - **Chat history commands**: `grok chat-history list|load|delete`
Session files are JSON with metadata and chat entries. The system uses `ChatHistoryPersistence` class for atomic writes and `ChatHistoryManager` for integration with the agent.
